description: React component for rendering a right-hand side (RHS) chat card in Mattermost, including scroll handling, user profile display, and plugin content rendering.

classes.name: RhsCard
classes.description: React component class for displaying a RHS chat card with scroll handling, user info, and plugin support.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the RhsCard component, setting up delayed scroll stop action and initial state.

methods.name: shouldComponentUpdate
methods.description: Optimizes re-rendering by comparing selected post props and scrolling state.

methods.name: handleScroll
methods.description: Handles scroll events, sets scrolling state, and triggers delayed scroll stop.

methods.name: handleScrollStop
methods.description: Resets scrolling state after scroll delay.

methods.name: handleClick
methods.description: Closes RHS on mobile view when the card is clicked.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the RHS card UI, including plugin content, user profile, and navigation link.
